# The boundary of enough under undetermined laws

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`the-boundary-of-enough-under-undetermined-laws` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](the-boundary-of-enough-under-undetermined-laws.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Under an undetermined law enough parts in two: some run can come to rest with its target met exactly where a reachable configuration stays and meets it; every run must exactly where every such configuration meets it and every run settles; under a determined law the two are one.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Possible enough: some run of a process from a configuration comes to rest with its target met exactly where a configuration reachable from it meets the target and has a step that stays. (`Becoming.Enough.RestsFrom`, `Becoming.Enough.Rests`, `Becoming.Enough.Stays`, `Becoming.Enough.stayAt`, `Becoming.Enough.prependState`, `Becoming.Enough.prependAct`, `Becoming.Enough.prepend`, `Becoming.Enough.trace_then_stay`, `Becoming.Enough.possibly_rests_iff`)
2. Assured enough: every run from a configuration comes to rest with its target met exactly where every reachable configuration with a step that stays meets the target and every run from it settles; the second part does not mention the target. (`Becoming.Enough.Settles`, `Becoming.Enough.settled_at`, `Becoming.Enough.assured_stays_meet`, `Becoming.Enough.assured_iff`)
3. Where every configuration can stay and meets the target, a run may still never settle: with two configurations and every step allowed, some run rests and the alternating run does not settle. (`Becoming.Enough.Free.process`, `Becoming.Enough.Free.alternate`, `Becoming.Enough.Free.alternating`, `Becoming.Enough.Free.not_ne_self`, `Becoming.Enough.Free.stays_meet_not_assured`)
4. Under a determined law some run from a configuration rests with its target met exactly where every run does, and exactly where the orbit reaches a configuration the law leaves unchanged that meets the target. (`Becoming.Enough.law_possibly_iff`, `Becoming.Enough.law_possibly_iff_assured`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. A process, a configuration and a target; each theorem names what it takes.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- When the runs of a process settle: the part of assured enough that does not mention the target is not characterized.
- Targets met along a course rather than at a configuration (more than now), choices divided between the seeker and others, and probabilistic enough.
- **Counterexample:** Two configurations, every step allowed, the target met everywhere: every configuration can stay, some run rests, and the alternating run never settles (Free.stays_meet_not_assured). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Enough.lean)
